title: Partition Scores Are Not System Scores: Deployment-Fidelity Gaps in Decomposed Algorithm Selection
abstract: arXiv:2609.13785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Oracle-style quantities, including virtual best solvers, selected-portfolio VBS, virtual-best encodings, and best-in-family summaries, are widely reported as upper bounds on what a deployable selector could achieve. In decomposed algorithm selection, an analogous partition-level score grants an oracle choice of the best algorithm within the selected family; once the family selector is fixed, the deployable system must replace that within-family oracle with a learned within-family selector.   We define the deployment-fidelity gap G(R) as the difference between partition-level and deployable end-to-end utility and derive two accounting consequences: a per-instance margin-regret stability condition that tells us when a partition-time family choice is deployment-optimal, and a sharp partition-only identification interval that, when it strictly crosses zero, prevents the partition-level report from certifying the deployable winner. translated_title: 分区分数并非系统分数：分解式算法选择中的部署保真度差距
translated_abstract: Oracle式的量化指标——包括虚拟最佳求解器、选定组合的VBS、虚拟最佳编码以及家族内最佳摘要——被广泛报告为可部署选择器所能达到性能的上界。在分解式算法选择中，类似的分区级分数允许以Oracle方式在选定家族内挑选最佳算法；而一旦家族选择器被固定，可部署系统就必须用一个学习得到的家族内选择器来替代该家族内Oracle。我们将部署保真度差距 G(R) 定义为分区级效用与可部署端到端效用之间的差值，并由此推导出两个核算结论：其一是逐实例的边际遗憾稳定性条件，用以判断分区时刻的家族选择何时在部署意义上是最优的；其二是仅基于分区数据的尖锐可识别区间，当该区间严格跨越零点时，分区级报告便无法认证可部署的获胜者。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“部署保真度差距 G(R)”概念，揭示分解式算法选择中分区级Oracle分数与可部署端到端性能之间存在系统性差距，并通过边际遗憾稳定性条件与仅分区可识别区间说明分区级报告通常无法认证真实部署中的获胜算法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the deployment-fidelity gap G(R), showing that partition-level oracle scores in decomposed algorithm selection systematically diverge from deployable end-to-end utility and generally cannot certify the true deployment winner, with stability conditions and partition-only identification intervals clarifying when such reports remain valid.
